text:
nina_se: Heads-up — AcmeBank is asking for a shortproof: fully EU traffic (no cross-border egress) for a 10-day sandbox. They want tenant traffic anchored to eu-west-1, BYOK, and a subprocessor inventory that excludes external error-reporting vendors. Can we run that on hosted or do we need Dedicated/Private?

sam_infra: We can do hosted with tenant pinning to eu-west-1 for the data plane. Control plane still in the control region but that doesn't carry PII. BYOK supported; customer must provide KMS key ARN and grant Encrypt/Decrypt to our service principal. Note: strict no-fallback means we can't failover to another region automatically — ops tradeoff.

ben_pricing: Quick on costs — two things: 1) regional egress/pinning surcharge (12% on token+egress units) for EU-only paths, 2) BYOK onboarding fee (one-time) $2,200 if they want our key ops to validate grants. If they choose Dedicated we'll quote reserved monthly. I can draft the sandbox quote.

nina_se: AcmeBank also marks Sentry/Datadog as unacceptable. Are those removable for a temporary sandbox?

omar_ops: For sandbox we can disable third-party telemetry and switch to our internal telemetry-only mode for that tenant. That requires a config flip + brief log retention downgrade. We can also stub error-reporting with a local sink. Will need a signed ops waiver for monitoring visibility.

tess_legal: Legal: no-fallback (preventing replication/failover) is an exception. We'll need a signed addendum to the DPA and a customer attestation that they understand potential DR implications. Also check the SQ answers for Q3 (data flows) and Q7 (subprocessors).

sam_infra: Technical details I'll need from the customer: KMS ARN, desired key policy (if any), expected TPS and streaming usage (affects session affinity). If streaming, session affinity TTL must exceed 30s to keep KV cache locality.

nina_se: I'll ask for KMS ARN and their list of blocked subprocessors. Can you draft the short checklist for them to fill?

omar_ops: Draft checklist (short):
- desired tenant_id / sandbox name
- KMS key ARN + grant confirmation
- list of disallowed subprocessors
- duration of sandbox (start/end dates)
- fallback allowed? (yes / canary / no)
- expected peak rps and streaming connections

ben_pricing: Also add: billing contact + PO number if they want the onboarding fee covered in the PO.

nina_se: I'm sending this checklist to AcmeBank now. FYI — if they insist on HSM-backed BYOK with no provider copies, point them to Dedicated/Private as recommended.

statusbot: ticket created: SRV-20456 (eu-sandbox-pin). Assigned: omar_ops, sam_infra. Estimated sandbox enablement: 36-48h after KMS ARN + signed waiver.

omar_ops: Ops timeline realistic: sandbox (non-prod) flip in 36h, prod-like tenant pin with no-fallback ~6 business days pending capacity and legal sign-off. We'll schedule maintenance window for the activation and run a short load smoke test.

because_of_compliance: (automated) note: please attach redacted subprocessor inventory to the thread before legal review.

tess_legal: Once they return SQ + signed waiver we can issue the DPA addendum template. I'll also prepare suggested language for the exception clause.

nina_se: Great — will update with forms. Also AcmeBank wants a short curl example showing endpoint pinned to eu-west-1 for their infra team. Could someone paste a sample?

sam_infra: paste:

curl -X POST https://api.redwood-inference.eu-west-1.example/v1/engines/text-gen-001/completions
  -H "Authorization: Bearer <TOKEN>"
  -H "X-Tenant-ID: acmebank-sandbox"
  -d '{"input":"hello"}'

sam_infra: That endpoint routes to the eu-west-1 pool when tenant routing is enabled.

nina_se: Perfect. I'll send checklist + curl + fee outline. Back here when they reply. :handshake:
